prepared_slices.name: T1: workflow and skill handoff contract
prepared_slices.owner_role: workflow author, accountable to registry maintainer
prepared_slices.verification: Writable, read-only, partial-write, proposed-only, and zero-action review replays per VER-001..007

prepared_slices.name: T2: behavioral regressions
prepared_slices.verification: Focused eval preflight and fresh captured-case/counterexample run with independent semantic grading; redact case content before committing

prepared_slices.name: T3: release checks
scope: registry validation and exported workflow review
prepared_slices.verification: pnpm validate:all; pnpm audit:sdlc; pnpm check-alignment; focused pnpm evals:preflight; reviewed release revision

blocking_gaps.gap: The PRD and SRS name only roles; no implementation owner has accepted T1 or T2.
blocking_gaps.owner_input_needed: Registry maintainer assigns an accepted workflow author and independent QA/eval reviewer.

blocking_gaps.gap: The operator approved the SRS, but the registry maintainer's separate architecture/contract review has not been evidenced.
blocking_gaps.owner_input_needed: Registry maintainer records independent review of source-of-truth, conditional persistence, and zero-action contracts.

completed_evidence: captured review available in a separate local worktree, not committed as a portable eval fixture
missing_evidence: implementation owner acceptance and independent registry maintainer review
behavioral eval fixture/replay and independent grading, required before claiming implementation success
decision_needed: Registry maintainer names and accepts implementation owner and independent QA/eval reviewer, and independently reviews the SRS.
